q.songTitle: Let’s Not Shit Ourselves (To Love and to Be Loved)
q.line: Well, the animals laugh from the dark of the wilderness
stanza: Well, the animals laugh from the dark of the wilderness
A baby cries hard in an apartment complex
As I pass in a car buried under the influence
The city's driving me out of my mind
I've seen a child, he's caught in the sad trap of gravity
He falls from the lowest branch of the apple tree
And lands in the grass, and weeps for his dignity
Next time, he will not aim so high
Yeah, next time, neither will I

partner.line: As I pass in a car buried under the influence
